texts.Migration_ErrorAlreadyStarted: This step has already started or is done. Click Refresh.
texts.Migration_ErrorKitUnreadable: The steps of this migration cannot be read: {0}
texts.Migration_ErrorLaterStepDone: Undo or unmark the steps after this one first.
texts.Migration_ErrorNoPermission: You need Manage BarnCRM Settings to run a migration.
texts.Migration_ErrorNotAllDone: Finish every step before ticking the checklist.
texts.Migration_ErrorNotDetected: {0} moves records from an app that is not installed in this org, so there is nothing to move.
texts.Migration_ErrorOutOfOrder: Finish the steps above this one first.
texts.Migration_ErrorTemplateMissing: The import template {0} for this step is missing. Restore it from Health Check, then start the step again.
texts.Migration_ErrorUnknownKit: This migration is not in this org. Go back to the Migration Kits list.
texts.Migration_ErrorUnknownName: This step reads {0}, which this org does not have or you cannot read.
texts.Migration_ErrorUnknownStep: That step or checklist item is not part of this migration. Click Refresh.
texts.Migration_Home_NoKits: No product with a Migration Kit is in this org. To bring in records from a file, use Import on the Data Manager tab.
texts.Migration_Home_Purpose: Move records from another product in this org into BarnCRM, one step at a time, with a check after each step and a list of what to switch off in the old product at the end.
texts.Migration_Home_Uninstall: When every migration is done and you no longer need to undo one, you can uninstall the BarnCRM Migration package. Your moved records stay; the kits, this tab and undo go.
texts.Migration_LoadConfirm: Load the {0} rows read from the other app into BarnCRM? Rows the preview rejected are skipped, and you can undo the load afterwards.
texts.Migration_LoadErrorMessage: The migration could not be read. Click Refresh to try again.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_CandidateCount: {0} Nonprofit Cloud households can be converted.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_ConfirmMessage: {0} Nonprofit Cloud household accounts become BarnCRM households, with their members when household membership is set to membership records. No Nonprofit Cloud record changes, and you can undo it from this section.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_Intro: Make Nonprofit Cloud's households BarnCRM households, once and in place: the same accounts, people, gifts and activities. Nonprofit Cloud's own groups and relationships are left exactly as they are. See what changes first, confirm the number, and undo it later if you need to.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_KeepNamesHelp: Marks each converted household Custom Name, so its name stays as your team typed it. Clear it to let BarnCRM name them from your naming settings. Greetings are filled from the members either way.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_NoneLeft: Every Nonprofit Cloud household you can see is already a BarnCRM household or marked to stay in Nonprofit Cloud.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_NotAvailable: BarnCRM found no Nonprofit Cloud households you can read in this org. You need read access to household groups and account contact relationships (the Group Membership permission set).
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_RunSummary: Nonprofit Cloud household conversion finished: {0} converted, {1} skipped because you cannot edit them, {2} refused (each refusal has its own Error Log entry).
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_SampleCaption: The first households, as Nonprofit Cloud has them
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_UndoMessage: {0} households go back to the record type, Household Model, name setting and primary contact they had before, and the members this conversion added are removed.
texts.Migration_NpcConversion_UndoSummary: Nonprofit Cloud household conversion undo finished: {0} put back, {1} not put back (the reasons follow in the Error Log).
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ConfirmMessage: {0} household accounts become BarnCRM households. No NPSP field changes, and you can undo it from this section.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorCountChanged: {0} households match now, not the {1} you confirmed. Refresh the panel and confirm the new number.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorJunctionMode: Household membership is set to membership records, and NPSP households keep their people on each contact's account. Set Household membership to Contact in BarnCRM Settings, People and Households, then adopt.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorNoPermission: You need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission to adopt or convert households. Ask your BarnCRM admin.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorNothingToAdo: There are no households left to adopt or convert, or none you can see.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorNothingToUnd: This adoption has nothing left to undo.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_ErrorRunning: An adoption or undo is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_Intro: Turn NPSP's household accounts into BarnCRM households, in place: the same records, people and Opportunities. See what changes first, confirm the number, and undo it later if you need to.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_KeepNamesHelp: Marks each adopted household Custom Name, so its name and greetings stay as NPSP had them. Clear it to let BarnCRM name them from your naming settings. Names typed by hand in NPSP are kept either way.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_MoreThanLimit: More households than that are waiting. One run adopts up to {0}; run it again for the rest.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_NoneLeft: Every NPSP household you can see is already a BarnCRM household.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_NotAvailable: BarnCRM found no NPSP household accounts in this org.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_NoteHasMembers: The household still has household member records. Undo the members step of the migration, or remove them, then undo again.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_NoteMembersKept: The account was put back, but the household member records the migration made could not be removed: {0}
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_NoteNotHousehold: The account is no longer a household, so it was left as it is.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_RunSummary: NPSP household adoption finished: {0} adopted, {1} skipped because you cannot edit them, {2} refused (each refusal has its own Error Log entry).
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_Running: An adoption or undo is running. This section updates by itself.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_Started: Started. This section updates as it runs.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_UndoMessage: {0} households go back to the record type, greetings, primary contact and custom name they had before.
texts.Migration_NpspAdoption_UndoSummary: NPSP household adoption undo finished: {0} put back, {1} not put back (the reasons follow in the Error Log).
texts.Migration_RefreshHint: Reading, previewing, loading and undoing run in the background. Click Refresh to see progress.
texts.Migration_RetireIntro: Once every step is done, switch off the old app's automations below in that app, and tick each one. BarnCRM never changes the old app.
texts.Migration_Started: Started. It runs in the background: click Refresh to see progress.
texts.Migration_UndoConfirm: Undo removes the {0} records this step created and puts back {1} changed values where nobody has changed them since. Undo this step?
